explanation: Those who are chosen and set apart for God through faith in Christ, called to a life separated from sin.
Neither the human soul nor God's breath; here it often refers to the guidance of the Holy Spirit in the communal life of a congregation.
The physical body and natural, earthly desires that can lead one away from God's will if not controlled by faith.
Dedication to a holy life; living in purity and separated from the sinful habits of the world.
The firm hope that Jesus Christ will return to raise the dead and gather his followers.
In this context, it refers to believers who have died before Christ's return but will be raised at his coming.
A temporary or imperfect form of something; here used to describe how the dead are not lost to God but await completion.
Deep and lasting joy that comes from God's presence and the hope of eternity, as opposed to earthly pleasure.
